technical_and_design_decisions: Extend Spring XD StreamDeployer and MessageBus provisioning components to explicitly track and destroy bound message bus resources (queues, topics, exchanges) upon stream destruction.
Implement an manifest file parser in the Spring XD Shell and REST API to allow deployment configuration ingestion directly from YAML/properties files.
Utilize Spring Integration ChannelInterceptor / GlobalWiretap features to support inline module tracing ('module.*.trace') and dynamic side-channel creation within stream definitions.
Enhance the Stream API to allow updating deployment properties on existing stream definitions without requiring explicit stream destruction and re-creation.
Implement the DEBS 2015 NYC Taxi Trip real-time analytics sample using Spring XD stream definitions (custom source/processor/sink modules for spatial-temporal analytics) as a reference architecture.
assumptions: Development is performed by a single developer proficient in Java 17+, Spring Framework, Spring Integration, and Spring XD stream processing internals.
The target deployment environment utilizes supported Spring XD message bus implementations (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Redis) with admin APIs for queue/topic lifecycle management.
Reference architecture deliverables (U5) and NYC Taxi challenge (U8) focus on functional POC stream definitions, custom modules, and documentation guidelines.
No external security or hardware infrastructure provisioning is included in this software development effort.

activities.activity_description: Design the resource lifecycle hooks, manifest file ingestion, dynamic deployment update mechanics, wiretap tracing interceptors, and reference architecture pipeline structures.

activities.activity_name: Message Bus Resource Cleanup Implementation (U1, U2)
activities.activity_description: Implement message bus unbinding and teardown logic in StreamDeployer to clean up associated queues, topics, and stale bindings when streams are destroyed.

activities.activity_name: Dynamic Stream Modification & Manifest File Import (U3, U4)
activities.activity_description: Implement stream deployment property editing API/CLI commands and extend deployment commands to ingest deployment manifests from external files.
Develop inline tracing logic with wildcard matching ('module.*.trace') via Spring Integration wiretaps and enable creation of arbitrary side-channels within stream flows.

activities.activity_name: Reference Architectures & NYC Taxi Analytics Implementation (U5, U8)
activities.activity_description: Build Spring XD reference architectures for common POC use cases and implement the DEBS 2015 NYC Taxi real-time streaming analytics benchmark pipeline.
Write automated unit and integration tests covering message bus cleanup, deployment updating, tracing, and author reference architecture documentation.
